verdict.rationale: Framer's first-party docs describe a built-in AI agent that works inside the project. In a conversation it creates editable pages, sections, copy and visuals, and you can take over on the canvas at any point. It handles site-wide styling such as typography, brand colors and dark mode, restructures layouts, makes designs responsive, and wires up interactions. A separate CMS agent sets up and updates collections, with a concrete CSV-import example. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the built-in agent works as claimed (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
